scope: Development-only extraction of strongest visited feasible TP snapshot; no new search or held-out claim
population: Initial legal original routed baseline plus every one of the 24 closure evaluations from reproduced frozen TP, including TP-rejected trials
eligibility: Native legal with WL and CPD each <=102% of original routed baseline
selection: Minimize (native WL, native CPD), then trial number with initial baseline numbered zero; same FP final-quality ordering
required_evidence: Verify reproduced TP implementation and all recorded closure identities
Exactly closure_calls trial reports, no omission of failed or rejected trials
Verify raw VPR log WL/CPD and routing-success/consistency markers against closure JSON for legal candidates
Verify canonical net/place/route hashes and route Placement_ID
Keep selected snapshot artifact bindings; do not overwrite TP final output or reroute it
Record full measured TP invocation cost and total oracle budget, even when selecting an early checkpoint
limits: Postprocessed frozen TP trajectory; not a rerun with FP acceptance guiding each TP step
TP budget 24 native closures differs from FP budgets; no equal-budget or speedup claim
The TP command uses prepared initial feedback; its construction cost was not remeasured
No per-design tuning; same final selection rule on every development design
No extra PR reroute cost charged to an already feasible native-routed reference
